description: This file is the main entry point for a Flutter-based note-taking app. It sets up Hive for local data storage, registers the Note adapter, initializes the app with theming, and defines the root widget NotesNativeApp, which configures providers and the MaterialApp with custom themes and initial page.

classes.name: NotesNativeApp
classes.description: Root widget of the app, setting up theme and state management using Provider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the app, including theme configuration and navigation to the main notes list page.
